history.summary: The Guntur District tourism portal identifies Mangalagiri as a long-established pilgrimage centre and describes the Panakala Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy temple on Mangalagiri hill.

name_origin.summary: Government tourism material describes Mangalagiri as a hill of bliss and the deity as Panakala Narasimha Swamy because of the traditional jaggery-water offering.
